content.name: Harpreet Grewal
content.title: Senior Medical Office Assistant
content.summary: Medical office assistant with eight years in walk-in, paediatric and family health team settings across the GTA. I keep busy clinics running on time, and recovered $46,000 in rejected OHIP claims in my current role by cleaning up billing codes and resubmission routines.

experience.title: Medical Office Assistant
bullets: Checked in up to 120 walk-in patients a day, verified OHIP health cards and triaged phone calls for four rotating physicians.
Booked specialist referrals and diagnostic imaging, tracking 300+ open referrals a month in a colour-coded EMR task list.
Prepared exam rooms, took vitals and assisted with dressing changes and ear syringing when the clinic nurse was off.

experience.title: Medical Office Assistant
bullets: Coordinated well-baby visits and vaccine schedules for a roster of 3,800 children across three pediatricians.
Moved paper vaccine records into Accuro EMR and reconciled them with public health immunization reports for school-age patients.
Answered parent calls in English, Punjabi and Hindi, and cut the phone message backlog from two days to same-day with a callback template.

experience.title: Senior Medical Office Assistant
bullets: Lead a front-desk team of 5 MOAs serving 9 physicians, a nurse practitioner and two allied health providers.
Recovered $46,000 in rejected OHIP claims in 18 months by fixing fee and diagnostic codes and setting a weekly resubmission routine.
Rebuilt the appointment templates in Accuro, reducing average patient wait time in the waiting room from 34 to 19 minutes.
Train new MOAs on privacy obligations under PHIPA and manage the clinic's records-release requests.
